dialogue.user: The JBU Deep Sea Encore Flat sounds interesting since it has so many reviews! But I'm really focused on comfort. Can you tell me what customers say about the comfort of those JBU flats? Do people mention them being good for walking or all-day wear? Also, do you know if they have any memory foam or cushioned insoles? I'm leaning toward something with memory foam or extra support for daily walking.
dialogue.agent:
Here's what I found on the **JBU by Jambu Women's Deep Sea Encore Flat** ($49.96, 4.5/5, 647 reviews):

**Key info from the product:** It's described as a "comfort walking shoe" with a non-marking recycled rubber outsole and all-terrain traction. However, it doesn't specifically mention memory foam insoles.

**Reviews say:**
- "Very comfortable" - one customer with **high arches** and chronic foot pain says these keep her feet happy even after wearing them out for long periods
- Another customer with **plantar fasciitis and arthritis** says they felt "even better than my diabetic shoes" and are the "next best thing to going barefoot"
- A third says they have a **"nice padded footbed"** and a wider toe box

Those are very strong comfort reviews from people with real foot issues!

Also, I found another option you might like even more that recently came up:

**Earth Origins Women's Shayla Sandal** - **$39.95** ★★★★ (4.5/5, 16 reviews) - This has a **cushioned, memory foam footbed with arch support**! It's described as "the perfect sandal for walking" with a lightweight outsole for grip and traction. If you want memory foam specifically, this could be a great fit.

Between all your options under $50:
- **JBU Deep Sea Encore** - proven comfort for problem feet, great for long walks, 647 reviews
- **Poppy Encourager** - memory foam, but fewer reviews and some durability concerns
- **Earth Origins Shayla** - memory foam **plus** arch support, purpose-built for walking

Would you like more details on the Earth Origins or JBU shoes?

top_reviews.text: I'm so glad I bought these shoes!  I got the oatmeal color in 7.5, my usual size, and they are just what I was hoping for.  I have high arches, and my feet can hurt pretty badly if they are not in good shoes.  I'm talking pain that is bad enough to keep me awake at night.  These shoes, however, are very comfortable.  I did wear them around the house at first to break them in because for some reason, it felt like the top might rub a blister. dialogue.user:
The JBU Deep Sea Encore Flat sounds fantastic based on those reviews—people with foot pain really raving about the comfort, so that's promising. 

Can you tell me more about the **Earth Origins Women's Shayla Sandal**? Are there any reviews mentioning whether they're truly comfortable for long walks? Also, I'm not totally sure about sandals for daily walking—do they offer enough support, or would the JBU flats be a better all-around walking shoe?
dialogue.agent:
Great questions! Here's the full picture on both:

---

**Earth Origins Women's Shayla Sandal** ($39.95, 4.5/5, 16 reviews) 
- **Memory foam footbed with arch support** — that cushioned, arch-supporting combo is ideal for walking
- Three adjustable straps for a custom fit
- Reviews are glowing: "most comfortable sandals I have ever owned" (customer with bunions & arthritis), "much more comfortable" than a famous expensive brand, and "perfect fit and so comfortable"
- However, it only has 16 reviews, so less data to go on

**JBU by Jambu Women's Deep Sea Encore Flat** ($49.96, 4.5/5, 647 reviews)
- A closed-toe Mary Jane style — more coverage and protection for everyday walking
- Described as a "comfort walking shoe" with all-terrain traction
- Reviews show it works great for people with plantar fasciitis, high arches, and arthritis
- Does not specifically mention memory foam, but has a "nice padded footbed"

---

**My honest take:** For **everyday walking** (going around town, errands, longer distances), I'd lean toward the **JBU Deep Sea Encore Flat**. Here's why:

1. **Closed-toe** gives you more protection and stability for all-day wear
2. **647 reviews** with a 4.5 rating is highly reliable feedback
3. Customers with real foot problems (plantar fasciitis, arthritis, high arches) specifically say they're great for long periods on their feet
4. The all-terrain traction sole makes them practical for different surfaces

The Earth Origins sandals are fantastic for warmer weather and have the memory foam + arch support combo you want, but sandals typically offer less foot coverage and support for very long walking days compared to a closed shoe.

Between the **Poppy Encourager** (memory foam, but durability concerns) and the **JBU Deep Sea Encore** (proven comfort, 647 reviews, walking-specific), the JBU seems like the smarter choice for your needs. What do you think?

top_reviews.title: Love, love, love!
top_reviews.text: I'm so glad I bought these shoes!  I got the oatmeal color in 7.5, my usual size, and they are just what I was hoping for.  I have high arches, and my feet can hurt pretty badly if they are not in good shoes.  I'm talking pain that is bad enough to keep me awake at night.  These shoes, however, are very comfortable.  I did wear them around the house at first to break them in because for some reason, it felt like the top might rub a blister.  However, I've since worn them out for long periods of time, and my feet have been very happy.  They are super cute too!  Highly recommend!

top_reviews.title: Feel great to my problem feet and joints!
top_reviews.text: I have plantar fasciiatis and other foot problems, as well as arthritis in all my joints.  This pair of Jambu shoes has felt even better to my feet and joints than my diabetic shoes!  I love them and may get another pair in the red for future use and maybe another color.  Another plus is that they don't look like Herman Munster shoes or sneakers!  I also bought some cloth insoles to wear with these instead of no-show socks and they work well.  Next best thing to going barefoot!
